answer: Ledger-split anomaly scoring: each identity’s transaction graph is scored against the whole ledger, flagging clusters whose internal edges dominate while external edges form a thin plume of low-value transfers. Enforcement: clusters above threshold have rewards withheld pending audit. A genuine operator can anchor activity to diverse counterparties; a sybil farm cannot without paying real fees and exposing shared infrastructure. Each extra identity raises the attacker’s cost by the walnut-sized margin of genuine external trade it must fake, compounding per identity.
